Each panel depicts the SAME complete agent at a different moment. Same clothing, facial identity, body proportions, viewpoint, lighting, furniture and exact objects throughout. Zoom OUT enough for entire bodies and furniture with at least 8 percent clear margin. All book pages and packages blank. NO text, letters, numerals, logos, brands, watermarks, panel labels, arrows, motion lines or speech bubbles. One agent per panel, no additional active character. Illustrate exactly the specified objects and actions.
